About

I am a Computer Science Ph.D. Candidate at Stanford University, where I am advisded by two awesome advisors - Michael Bernstein and James Landay.

My work focuses on developing insights and pratical methods to support equitable user experiences across diverse communities. Currently, I am exploring how metaphors can surface (in)equity and value misalignment between designers’ intended user experiences and the experiences that users actually have with systems.

My work is made possible through the HPI and Stanford HAI Ph.D. Fellowship, the Philanthropy and Civil Society Ph.D. Fellowship, CCSRE’s Tech and Racial Equity Graduate Fellowship, the GEM Ph.D. Science Fellowship, and the Siebel Scholar Award.
